findings.title: Which Voices Move Markets? Speaker Identity and the Cross-Section of Post-Earnings Returns
findings.key_result: Speaker-weighted FinBERT on 6.5M sentences from 16,428 earnings calls. Monthly long-short alpha 2.03% unexplained by FF5, Spearman IC=0.142 OOS. 2015-2025 S&P 500.
findings.hypothesis_connection: H168 — directly validates speaker-weighted FinBERT approach
findings.staged_reason: Already staged as H168 in prior sessions; confirms design is correct

findings.title: Extracting the Structure of Press Releases for Predicting Earnings Announcement Returns
findings.key_result: 138,000 press releases (2005-2023). FinBERT on 8-K press release structure equally informative as EPS surprise for announcement-day returns. Section extraction improves signal purity.
findings.hypothesis_connection: H163/H174 — direct validation; suggests H175 combining section extraction + EPS surprise

findings.title: SAE-FiRE: Enhancing Earnings Surprise Predictions Through Sparse Autoencoder Feature Selection
findings.key_result: Sparse autoencoders for interpretable feature extraction from financial documents. Outperforms dense feature extraction for earnings surprise prediction.
findings.hypothesis_connection: H172 — could improve CLS embedding classifier that failed due to high dimensionality/limited data
findings.staged_reason: H172 failed primarily due to limited OOS n=35, not feature quality; SAE fix is premature until 8-K cache is larger

findings.title: Janus-Q: End-to-End Event-Driven Trading via Hierarchical-Gated Reward Modeling
findings.key_result: 62,400 annotated articles (10 event types). Hierarchical Gated Reward Model. Sharpe +102%, direction accuracy +17.5% vs baselines. CAR-labeled training data available.
findings.hypothesis_connection: H177 (new) — hierarchical reward model could fix H172's return-distribution problem
findings.flag_reason: ~20h effort; requires Janus-Q dataset download; flagged for Kevin review

findings.title: Generating Alpha: A Hybrid AI-Driven Trading System Integrating Technical Analysis, ML and Financial Sentiment
findings.key_result: FinBERT + XGBoost + regime filter. 135.49% return over 24 months (Jan 2023 - Jan 2025).
findings.hypothesis_connection: H165 — regime filtering on PEAD signals (VIX > threshold) may improve H163 beyond H174
findings.staged_reason: H165 VIX benchmark (H165a) already partially confirmed; this paper doesn't add novel design insights

findings.title: Corporate Earnings Calls and Analyst Beliefs
findings.key_result: LLM counterfactual transcripts varying topical emphasis. Narratives significantly improve prediction of realized earnings AND analyst expectations beyond quantitative content.
findings.hypothesis_connection: H168 — supports topic distribution extraction from transcripts as additional signal layer
findings.staged_reason: Already noted in NLP wiki; implementation complexity too high for H168 v1 scope

findings.title: Advanced Deep Learning Techniques for Analyzing Earnings Call Transcripts
findings.key_result: Comparative benchmark: FinBERT > BERT > ULMFiT for financial sentiment extraction from earnings call transcripts. IC and direction accuracy metrics reported.
findings.hypothesis_connection: H168 — confirms FinBERT as optimal model choice; no new alpha angle
findings.staged_reason: Confirms existing design decision; no new hypothesis

findings.title: Sentiment-Aware Stock Price Prediction with Transformer and LLM-Generated Formulaic Alpha
findings.key_result: LLM auto-generates formulaic alphas from sentiment + technical features. LLM-generated alphas significantly improve Transformer accuracy over sentiment-only baseline.
findings.hypothesis_connection: H173 (NOT CONFIRMED) — LLM-generated adaptive alpha rules could revive sentiment surprise signal
findings.staged_reason: Interesting approach but high implementation complexity; H176 (GPT-4o-mini relative sentiment) is simpler path to same goal

findings.title: FinDPO: Financial Sentiment Analysis for Algorithmic Trading through Preference Optimization of LLMs
findings.key_result: DPO fine-tuning on LLMs for financial sentiment. 67% annual return, Sharpe 2.0, 5bps transaction costs. 11% accuracy improvement vs supervised FinBERT baselines.
findings.hypothesis_connection: H176 (new) — proxy for DPO-style relative sentiment using GPT-4o-mini prompting; simpler implementation path

findings.title: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
findings.key_result: Multi-agent framework with specialized roles (fundamental, sentiment, technical, risk manager). Improvements in cumulative returns, Sharpe, MaxDD vs baselines.
findings.hypothesis_connection: H165 (TradingAgents macro-regime gate, PARTIAL CONFIRMED) — already in pipeline
findings.staged_reason: Already staged as H165; this paper was already the source. H165 step 2 (full TradingAgents integration) already in QUEUED status.

findings.title: sec-parser: Parse SEC EDGAR HTML documents
findings.key_result: MIT license, actively maintained, ~800 stars. Extracts semantic tree from EDGAR HTML filings. Section-level access to 8-K items.
findings.hypothesis_connection: H163/H175 — replaces regex-based 8-K parsing with structured section extraction

findings.title: LLM-Enhanced-Trading (Ronitt272)
findings.key_result: Real-time FinGPT sentiment from news/Reddit. End-to-end pipeline for news monitoring + historical backtest.
findings.hypothesis_connection: Template for real-time 8-K monitoring; less relevant than sec-parser + edgartools
findings.staged_reason: Low novelty; existing wiki already covers this pattern

staged_summary.description: New script: H175 PEAD-NLP with sec-parser Item 2.02 extraction + EPS surprise gate
New script: H176 GPT-4o-mini relative sentiment vs prior quarter (revival of H173)
New script: H177 hierarchical reward model for PEAD CAR prediction (FLAGGED for Kevin review — ~20h effort)
Wiki update: add sec-parser to NLP & Alternative Data tools page
